name: Arc Collapse
description: The final descent into the ringworld's Arc Core chamber. Three apex aliens guard the destabilization trigger. The Oracle Prime has one chance to collapse the ring. Make it count.

dialogue.speaker: Oracle Prime
dialogue.line: The final seal is within reach. All strains have converged. The Arc must be destroyed, or it will consume everything.

dialogue.speaker: Lia
dialogue.line: We're deep now. The walls are bleeding circuitry. I'm reading three distinct command signatures ahead.

dialogue.speaker: Oracle Prime
dialogue.line: The Warden, the Tyrant, and the Prime. They will not yield. But you carry something they cannot parse—a corrupted save file from a world that shouldn't exist.

dialogue.speaker: Oracle Prime
dialogue.line: Oracle Warden neutralized. Its shield network is down. The Tyrant is gravitic-locking the chamber.

dialogue.speaker: Lia
dialogue.line: Gravity Tyrant is dead. But Phantom Prime just phased out of reality. Watch your flanks—it can strike from anywhere.

dialogue.speaker: Oracle Prime
dialogue.line: Phantom Prime dissipated. The Arc Core is exposed. One shot. Make it count.

dialogue.speaker: Lia
dialogue.line: Arc Core destabilized. The ring is collapsing. We have ninety seconds to reach the evacuation point. Run.

dialogue.speaker: Oracle Prime
dialogue.line: Evacuation complete. The ring is gone. The simulation has ended. Welcome to the real.

easter_eggs.name: Warthog Launch
easter_eggs.description: Vehicle launches into the sky. A classic testing bug turned feature.

easter_eggs.name: Glitch Text
easter_eggs.description: Screen displays corrupted text. The asset cache is rejecting malformed glyphs.

easter_eggs.name: Infinite Ammo
easter_eggs.description: Weapon never reloads. Someone definitely edited the ammo tables.

easter_eggs.name: CE Release Bug
easter_eggs.description: Fourth-wall break: the game acknowledges it is a build with known issues.
